name: review_gate_policy
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

requested.description: Requested investigation-pass budget; clamped to [0, 5]. Non-numeric or omitted values default the limit to 5.

count.description: Investigation passes already used; non-numeric or omitted values are treated as 0.

approve.description: Truthy value (accepts '1'/'true'/'yes'/'on' as strings) indicating a human already approved; opens the gate.

approvalMode.description: When exactly 'human', the gate is always open regardless of approve.

canInvestigate.description: True when passes used (count) is still below limit.

actions.description: Actions available to the reviewer: includes 'investigate' only when canInvestigate is true.

gate.description: Whether the checkpoint is open, as a string for use by a value-param SWITCH: 'true' when approve is truthy or approvalMode='human'.
